visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a montage of photos comparing 2016 and 2025. In the 2016 photo, a woman with short reddish-brown hair in a white shirt stands before a university stage. The 2025 photos show her sister at a university gate and the two of them together with a mascot. (2) A woman with dark hair wearing a black and white checkered blouse walks down a wide campus path. The path is bordered by tall green trees and modern grey university buildings. She smiles and waves her hand at the camera. (3) The camera moves inside a student cafeteria. It shows food display cases filled with realistic plastic models of ramen and rice bowls. A man in a black uniform is seen behind the service counter. (4) Close-up shots highlight a refrigerated unit with small side dishes like tofu, a collection of condiment bottles, and a self-service tea station. The woman is seen holding a tray containing a beef bowl, soup, and gyoza. A close-up shows a detailed paper receipt. (5) Inside the university co-op store, she browses shelves of packaged bread and snacks. She shows a gold Keio-branded bookmark and then tries on a navy blue cap with a white 'K' logo. Boxes of university-branded Yokan are shown in a basket. (6) Back in the cafeteria, the woman sits at a table and eats with chopsticks. She also drinks from a small juice box with a straw, looking directly at the camera with a smile. (7) The final scene is in an indoor gym with a wooden floor. The woman and a small boy in a grey shirt are playing a ring-toss game with colorful plastic rings and a wooden board.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 2016年. [Subtitle]: 十年前 我來日本讀慶應別科. (2) [Logo]: 2025年. [Subtitle]: 十年後 我妹妹也來了！ (3) [Subtitle]: 講到留學生活 最懷念的事物之一 絕對有學生食堂. (4) [Subtitle]: 前陣子陪妹妹去學校 順便回味一下. (5) [Subtitle]: 小菜全部都是自取式 也有拉麵、丼飯可以點. (6) [Subtitle]: 重點是超便宜 便宜到不可思議. (7) [Subtitle]: 醬料隨便加 茶水自由喝. (8) [Subtitle]: 我拿這麼多才日幣781円. (9) [Subtitle]: 完全是學生的天堂. (10) [Subtitle]: 除了食堂外 還有福利社、書店. (11) [Subtitle]: 有賣麵包、便當、甜點外 還有學校自己出的周邊. (12) [Subtitle]: 慶應有書籤 手帕 帽子 甚至還有出羊羹. (13) [Subtitle]: 整體很 日本校園日劇漫畫感. (14) [Subtitle]: 大家可以在離峰時間 來體驗看看. (15) [Subtitle]: 我是在 日本育兒的RU醬 追蹤我看更多日本生活情報.
